reviews.text: The best grooming in Houston TX
Taking my Dog to dog house pet salon more than 6 years for grooming,they doing really well specially Donna is very nice. I highly recommend this place for your babies 🙏
Great service

The Best Service I found in Houston and especially for grooming and dog daycare plus boarding. Very very knowledgeable and kind people and I’ve used them for five years. Ask for Maddie! She’s the best!!!  Above and beyond!!!
Dropped off a few rescues for Doodle Dandy Rescue that we received early in the morning. Polite and caring workers.

Donna is an excellent groomer. I found her on IG and I am happy with her service. My fur baby is a Shih Tzu and not many groomers are skilled in groomer this breed. Services provided are teeth brushed, wash and cut. See you all soon!!

DONNA AND STAFF ARE THE BEST IN HOUSTON!!!!!!!

VMCAUTOGROUP  PORSCHE
ROBERT & MOLLIE NEAL!
Best groomers in Houston. I have taken my dogs to the Galleria location for years. The prices are good and the service is fantastic.
I wouldn’t be able to manage my work schedule without doggy daycare, they love to play. The staff is outstanding & they love on my pups too! A BIG thank you to Melissa for all you do…you’re AWESOME.

I have been bringing my multiple dogs to Donna for grooming since she opened her own salon years ago. Donna has always had the best front desk staff : welcoming, remembering me & my dogs & calling me promptly when they are done for immediate pick up. I also saw a similar breed to mine on her rescue website. Contacting her to see the dog & within 2 days I adopted Stella. Donna also recommended an excellent Dog Trainer, Cody-360 K-9 Training, who I’m taking classes now from him. Years ago no I got an excellent Dog Sitter rec from her, too.
Thank you Donna for taking care of all my dog needs. You are my go-to for any dog services or questions.

I've trusted Dog House Pet Salon with my dogs for the past 8 years for both grooming and boarding, and I couldn't be happier with the care they've received. Jeff and Cameron are truly awesome people who genuinely care about the pets they work with. Whether it's a routine grooming appointment or an extended boarding stay, I always have complete confidence that my dogs are in great hands.

The staff is professional, friendly, and treats every dog like family. My dogs always come home looking great, happy, and well cared for. Finding a place you can trust with your pets is priceless, and Dog House Pet Salon has earned that trust year after year. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality grooming and boarding services.
They consistently do a great job. Front desk is always helpful and friendly. They do a great job of keeping you informed on when they will be done. My dog Finley comes home happy and looking great.
My pups first cut was a pleasant experience. Everyone loved my dog as much as I do and we look forward to another visit
Stinky, loud place with not enough actual space for the dogs to run or walk around in. Smells like urine since they have FAKE GRASS. Trash. Wish places for dogs like this didn’t exist we need better.

This could be a training opportunity or maybe an opportunity for someone to find another job. It was my first time taking my poodle here. I explained to the groomer that she had a surgery on her right leg over a year ago. The vet said she is fine now, but this is something that always stresses me, and I have to bring it up so she is handled with care or not too much stress on that leg. I have been to the Pearland location multiple times, but galleria is now the closest since we moved. My dog is a rescue and was hesitant about going to the back with the front desk lady. I helped her out, since she is truly not good with dogs and her whole vibe was that she hates dogs and didn’t want to be there. Understand myself and my dog also are nervous because it’s our first time there and she is making it worse. Before the door could completely close behind her. I saw her dragging my dog so aggressively by her collar. I sat in my car for a while thinking I’ve made a mistake leaving her there. I had to go to work I called them and expressed that is not okay. If you are not going to treat animals with compassion and don’t like you’re job what are you doing there. This employee is a liability.

we have been taking our fur baby Romeo here for over a year now and I have always been happy with the service and care. Great business family owned and operated this is definitely our babies home away from home.
We take our three dogs here every 2-3 weeks. The staff does a great job with our kids. They are very responsive to our needs. And communication is fantastic. Highly recommend The Dog House

From the moment I walked into The Dog House Pet Salon, I felt completely welcomed. The staff was incredibly friendly and warm, and that first impression meant everything to me. My baby Kera can be very nervous around new people, but they were so patient and gentle with her. They treated her with genuine love and care, and I could immediately tell she was in good hands.

When they called me to let me know she was ready, I was excited—but nothing prepared me for how amazing she looked when I picked her up! The results were absolutely incredible. She looked beautiful, happy, and so well taken care of.

I am beyond happy with the service and the entire team. They have definitely gained a new loyal customer. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of my sweet girl!

Hi Emily,

Thank you so much for the ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ review! We truly appreciate you taking the time to support The Dog House Pet Salon.

It means the world to our team to know you had a great experience. We look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon! 🐾💕
Met some of the people working there and the groomer. They even have boarding.  Check them out!
Thank you! We’re glad to hear you found our pricing reasonable and appreciate you taking the time to share your experience. We look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon! 🐾 …
We love Donna!!! She’s been grooming my puppy son for over 10 years.

Donna did a fantastic job on my Roxi girl. She came out so happy & squeaky clean!! I am not from the area & just here for work for a while, but wish I was, because I would come here again & again. Price was amazing for the quality of service given to Roxi. Highly highly recommend & will be returning before I head back home!!

This is the best place!!!  I started bringing my puppy here for socialization and training.  She does puppy kindergarten.  I get weekly videos updates on all the new skills she learns.  I also get a detailed report.  They do the most adorable photoshoots and themed treats.  My heart melts when I bring my little Shelby here and she runs in to happily greet the staff!!!  I can’t thank the staff here enough for giving my puppy so much love.

I decided to take my dog to this place because he received a gift card, so I thought it would be a good opportunity to try their services. Unfortunately, my experience was not very good.

When I called to confirm the appointment, the person who answered didn’t give me the correct information about which location my reservation was made for. Still, I decided to go, trusting that they could assist me once I arrived.

When I got there, the front desk staff was not friendly. I felt that their attitude was somewhat discriminatory toward Latino customers. I don’t understand why they advertise that they speak Spanish if they clearly feel uncomfortable assisting people who do. One of the girls spoke Spanish, but she never offered to communicate in it, even after I mentioned that my English wasn’t very fluent.

Later, they called a lady who did speak Spanish — she was kind, patient, and professional. She took the time to explain everything clearly, and I could tell she was a genuinely good person. I regret not remembering her name because she was truly the best part of my visit.

The biggest issue happened when I came back to pick up my dog. I had paid for a service that included nail trimming and filing, ear cleaning, and a full bath, but when I checked, his nails were not properly trimmed or filed, his ears were not cleaned, and his coat didn’t smell fresh or clean. The work seemed to have been done with little attention to detail and care.

I’m not the type of person who usually leaves negative reviews, but I believe it’s important to share my experience honestly and respectfully. I truly hope the owners can read this and take it as an opportunity to improve.
Everyone deserves to be treated with respect and to receive quality service — regardless of the language they speak or where they come from.
I really like my dogs, they come out happy and their hair is cut very well, just like I like it.
Good staff, professional , quick and nice grooming for my dog. Happy that I found this place.
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are glad you chose The Dog House. We look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon! 🐾 …

I've been here 3 times for a local rescue with whom I volunteer. The staff is friendly and communicates well. The puppers seem happy to be there! I love the big playground for them out front. The big dogs were playing when I went once and they all seemed so content playing with their doggy friends!

My cat died because, supposedly, it's a veterinary clinic, and my cat died right at your doorstep. Why register a grooming salon with the name "veterinary clinic"? It's your fault for not knowing how to properly advertise. My cat died if it's not a veterinary clinic; don't use that name. I mean, you search for veterinary clinics, and you come up. How illogical! Think about it: if there's an emergency, you look for a veterinary clinic, and you don't even know how to advertise properly. Learn that advertising is what attracts attention, and drop the "veterinary clinic" name because you're useless.
Very professional. They definitely love pets and treat them well. Highly recommend

We really appreciate your 5-star rating! 🐾 It's heartwarming to know that you and your furry companions enjoyed your time with us. Our team loves making each visit special and we can't wait to welcome you back! …

Best Place in town!!
Friendly, employee's are wonderful with my fur babies!
My dog comes back decently cleaned. It's pricey but helpful, seeing as I'm not able to bathe my dog anymore. They are doing a me a great service.
Melissa and Maddy always go above and beyond and are very friendly!

I can't say enough good things about Melissa at The Dog House Saloon! My dog, Daisy, is a rescue with a tough past, and grooming has always been a stressful experience for her. But Melissa is incredibly patient, kind, and understanding. She takes the time to make Daisy feel comfortable, never rushing the process and always working at Daisy’s pace. It’s clear that she truly cares about the well-being of the dogs she grooms. Thanks to Melissa, Daisy is finally able to have a calm and positive grooming experience. Highly recommend her to anyone, especially if you have a nervous or traumatized pup! 🐾💙

Keilan and Karla do an AMAZING job with my Bernese mountain dog Zelda!  Maddy at reception is always such a pleasure and gets us checked in with no hassle or wait. Thank you so much for your amazing work! We love you!
Maddie and the rest of the staff are truly amazing,thank you so much!
These folks are great. They’ve been grooming our Goldendoodle for several years. They’re always prompt and Bitsy looks good. I highly recommend The Dog House.

I came to the Dog House through Donna's Love Pet Rescue or Donna who owns the business and is the head groomer. I was lucky enough to adopt a pure bred Great Pyrenees named Luna through Donna's rescue and then fortunate to have Donna let me board my Pry while I was fostering her and take her to doggy day care as a DLPR foster.

Donna's grooming, her staff and her facility are top notch. Now that I own Luna, my Pry, when I take her to the Dog House, she doesn't like it at my home anymore. Not enough action I guess. 🤣

If you are looking for phenomenal grooming, boarding, or to foster a rescue dog through Donna's rescue, she has plenty at the Dog House that need a temporary home until they find their forever home. And Donna provides all their needs (food, bed, leash, and boarding if you go out of town).
I adore this group of people!

Wanted to update my initial review with comments about their boarding options at the location on Richmond. They have affordable prices and my pets don't want to come home. 🤦‍♀️They have such a good time at the free daycare that is provided during the boarding process which I've only had one other facility that I use provide. Also, I and my dogs adore the front staff Maddie and Melissa. Melissa in particular is so attentive, calm and kind. You can see why she works with animals. Love, love, love this place. ❤️❤️❤️
